jira.summary: Provision AKS cluster for Voice Catalyst workloads in QA
jira.description: Please provision an AKS cluster for the Voice Catalyst workloads in QA. Environment: qa. Resource prefix: voicecatalyst-aks. aks_version: 1.30.3, sku_tier: Standard, identity_type: SystemAssigned, admin_username: azureuser. The SSH public key is held in the pipeline variable AKS_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY. Private cluster is required. Target service repo is pss_fabric_app_iac_sample.
